convert_sd3_controlnet_dtype: run the script to convert an SD3.5 ControlNet checkpoint to Diffusers format with fp16 or bf16 dtype
load_original_checkpoint: summarize the load_original_checkpoint function that loads a checkpoint from a local path or HuggingFace repo
convert_sd3_controlnet_checkpoint_to_dif: review the convert_sd3_controlnet_checkpoint_to_diffusers function that remaps checkpoint keys and splits QKV tensors
